verdict.rationale: Buzz's source is publicly readable at github.com/block/buzz. Its own docs describe it as an open-source codebase: VISION.md says "same OSS codebase" and AGENTS.md maps block/buzz as "OSS source — relay, desktop app, mobile app, CLI, agent harness". Missing for 10: the specific license is never named (no LICENSE file or SPDX identifier is cited), and there is no independent confirmation of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: same OSS codebase, same URL-is-your-workspace experience either way
